subject: New Biophysical Brain Model Explains How Dementia Unravels Memory Formation
script: From Agewell Brief: New Biophysical Brain Model Explains How Dementia Unravels Memory Formation. A newly published theoretical framework reveals how systemic failures in neural network synchronization disrupt memory encoding, offering fresh insight into the physical origins of Alzheimer’s disease. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
